name: Necrologist
bio: Archetype: Immortality, DMG Buff, AP Greedy. ⌽ Provides a powerful DMG Dealt bonus through her Ult which also applies [Prayer] on other allies, preventing them from dying when they are killed. [Prayer] cannot stack; additional applications become heals instead. ⌽ Has some niche ST [Stats Up] and [Status Pos] dispel on her S2. ⌽ Although she cannot gain [Prayer] or DMG Bonus from her Ult, she does gain [Prayer] at the start of battle and heals herself whenever ally [Prayer] is dispelled.
